text:
This looks like a paper plate of about 20-22 cm, holding three avocado wedges. The wedges are roughly 8-9 cm long and 3-4 cm wide.

Each wedge is about a quarter to a third of an avocado, so about 40-50 g with the skin on. Together that is roughly 130 g. If the skin is still on, the edible portion is closer to 110 g.

Avocado has about 1.6 kcal/g, so 130 g comes to about 200 kcal.

```json
{"kcal": 200, "mass_g": 130}
```
